gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma at unequivocal first recurrence or progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: L19TNF is a fully human fusion protein consisting of human tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α fused to the L19 antibody in scFv format, specific to the extra-domain B of fibronectin.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy of L19TNF Plus Lomustine in Patients With Glioblastoma at First Progression

agents.drug_class_hint: antibody-cytokine fusion protein (scFv L19 against fibronectin EDB fused to TNF-alpha)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: selectively delivers TNF to the tumor site; TNF induces apoptosis or necrosis in certain target cells and exerts inflammation and immunity

coder_notes: Phase 2 randomises L19TNF + lomustine vs lomustine alone, both within a registered arm labelled EXPERIMENTAL (Phase II part: Signal Seeking), hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Lomustine dose varies between phase 1 cohorts (90 vs 110 mg/m2) but only as part of dose finding for the combination; lomustine is coded soc_backbone as the question is L19TNF. MGMT is an entry requirement only in that the status must be known, not a particular status.
